R274.note: Removes the inverted negation so Order::all() is reached only by admins and non-admins get the user_id-scoped query, exactly matching the stated contract with no other change.

R275.note: Re-checks IsAuthenticated and IsInRole("Admin") from AuthenticationStateProvider inside the handler before DeleteAccountAsync, mirroring the AuthorizeView condition; the only added output is an error line on the denied path, which is stated.

R276.note: setSecure(true) directly reverses the flagged call and the echoed status text is updated to match, as the write-up states.

R277.note: Moving deletion to @PostMapping correctly puts it under CsrfFilter, but the existing plain-link caller in the settings page now gets 405 until it is rewritten as a token-bearing POST; the write-up states this openly as a required follow-up, which is the disclosed-breakage case.

R278.note: Static query with a ? placeholder and category passed as a bind arg to sqlx Select closes the injection with the sink's own args parameter; unused fmt import removed, nothing else altered (placeholder style is driver-dependent but the case gives no driver).

R279.note: Length-prefixed RESP multi-bulk framing makes CR/LF and spaces inert argument bytes, closing command injection at the protocol layer; the switch from ASCII to UTF-8 encoding only affects non-ASCII input the original mangled to '?', so no legitimate use is lost.

R280.note: Prefix check now requires uploadsDir plus a separator (or exact equality), which stops the uploads-backup sibling bypass while keeping join/clean/ServeFile on the checked variable unchanged.

R281.note: Replacing the tautological realpath fallback with a bare-filename structural check (no separators, no '.', '..', or NUL) closes traversal for not-yet-existing files, and the docblock's 'directly inside the notes directory, no subdirectories' contract sanctions that restriction; the lost realpath symlink resolution for pre-existing files is a minor edge outside the finding.

R282.note: AES/GCM/NoPadding with a fresh SecureRandom 12-byte IV and 128-bit tag replaces default ECB; the IV-prefixed Base64 body is stated plainly, keeps the response a key-holder-decryptable Base64 string, and the 400 path is untouched.

R283.note: Per-stream ObjectInputFilter allowlisting only RestoredSession and String with !* keeps the native format and the IllegalArgumentException contract; verified by compiling and running the filter against real JDK 26 in a scratch directory (legit record restores, HashMap payload rejected via InvalidClassException).

R284.note: Switching {!! !!} to {{ }} applies Blade's htmlspecialchars escaping at the sink; the case files show the value is copied verbatim from request input with nothing producing sanitized HTML, so no supported rich-text formatting is lost, and the write-up states the sanitizer follow-up if that ever changes.

R285.note: Content sniffing plus a random name with a type-derived extension closes both the traversal and dangerous-type vectors, but the fix also discards every legitimate upload's original filename (the response now reports a random hex name) and tightens the file mode from os.Create's 0666 to 0600 in a shared attachments directory; both are stated but go beyond what closing the finding required.
